title: Fixed Raised-Lever Citrus Press
description: One original fixed raised-lever cafe citrus-press visual prop. A single grounded C frame integrates the base, rear upright, upper bridge and a true front-slotted cup shelf. A thick faceted through-open funnel cup rests on the two shelf wings. A separate raised conical press head and integral stem meet the upper bridge underside; a single fixed lever has a full rear seat on the bridge and a dark grip end. Four closed editable meshes, three opaque untextured PBR materials. The cone is fixed30mm above the cup rim; no fruit, juice, collection vessel, hidden linkage, working articulation, pressure, food-contact suitability, manufacture or safety certification is claimed. Metres, Z up, front -Y, horizontal-bounds-centred ground origin.
